record.refute_by: By-name load reads `.json` twice and overwrites active `ProspectInfo` before `ReadFromProspectBlob` (`0x1418e6240`), which ignores `FBase64::Decode`; runtime corrupt-blob test open

cells.lead: SL-002: From-file load failure enters a fatal-output facility

record.lead: Blob result and declared compressed length may diverge

cells.lead: SL-004: Blob result and declared compressed length may diverge
cells.static_evidence: M-169/E-009, M-169/E-022; F-737 (M-776, M-777): `WriteToProspectBlob` (`0x1418fa200`) sets `DataLength=TotalLength`; `0x1418e6240` ignores `DataLength`
cells.what_would_establish_or_refute_a_problem: `FBase64::Decode` resizes `CompressedData` to `GetDecodedDataSize` while `UncompressMemory` reads `TotalLength` bytes (OOB if `decoded<TotalLength`); runtime test open
